bio: An unmissable restaurant in a small village in the beautiful Karst region, with a classic, beautifully kept dining room with the intimate feel of a private lounge. The owners here are friendly and welcoming and keen to showcase the best of their region. With enthusiasm and expertise, skilful owner-chef Ksenija Krajšek Mahorčič adds a personal, technical touch to Slovenian ingredients, resulting in dishes of the highest quality. Among the appetisers, a good example of his sustainable approach is the puffed wild garlic chip topped with a sea bass cream made from fish scraps. Also recommended is the local roast lamb served with cider made from home-grown apples and a garlic potato mash. Don’t forget to leave space for one of the exquisite desserts, such as the refreshing and delicious yogurt ...
